sources.title: Synthetic training fixture, not real business evidence
sources.coverage: Four example orders, one invented period

claims.text: The synthetic fixture contains four order records.
Under the stated assumptions, next-period orders would be five.
claims.basis: Illustrative scenario: 4 * 1.25 = 5; not an estimated forecasting model.
assumptions: Illustrative 25% growth, selected for demonstration only
claims.limitations: No historical series or real business evidence; not a prediction interval.

claims.text: Customer demand may explain a future increase.
claims.basis: Candidate explanation to test against alternatives.
claims.limitations: No demand observations or counterfactual are available.
